---
name: Hardware bench report
about: Share a result from a physical board or peripheral
title: "[Bench] "
---

## Hardware and tools

- Board model and PCB revision
- Sensor, USB bridge, or programmer model, if relevant
- Host OS and architecture
- HARDwhere version and vendor tool, core, library, or driver version

## Steps and result

- Operation you tried and the command or example you used
- How you identified the physical target
- What you expected and what you observed
- Short, redacted log or measurement showing the result

Remove credentials, private SSH connection details, and full device serial numbers from the report.
